faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Quick answers for students, teachers and staff.

q1.q: How do I get an account?
q1.a: Your school administrator creates it for you. You receive a username (your student or employee ID) and a temporary password, which you change the first time you log in.

q2.q: I forgot my password. What should I do?
q2.a: Ask your administrator to reset it. You will get a new temporary password and be asked to choose your own at the next login.

q3.a: After 5 wrong passwords the account locks for 15 minutes to keep it safe. Wait, or ask your administrator to unlock it.

q4.q: When can students see their grades?
q4.a: Only after the teacher submits them and an administrator approves and publishes them. Until then, grades are not visible to students.

q5.a: English and Khmer. Use the language button at the top of any page. Menus and page titles are in Khmer today, and more is being translated.

q6.q: Can I use it on my phone?
q6.a: Yes. It runs in the web browser on a phone, tablet or computer. There is nothing to install.
